input: Explore local street food markets this month

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many markets the user wants to visit shapes whether this is a single outing or a recurring monthly habit, and how much planning is needed.
The city or neighborhood determines which specific markets exist, their schedules, and how far the user needs to travel.
Going solo, with a partner, family, or a group changes logistics like timing, accessibility needs, and how much food variety to prioritize.
A budget per outing affects how many stalls they can try and whether cost-tracking or deal-finding should be part of the plan.
Dietary preferences or cuisine types they want to focus on (e.g., vegan, Asian, desserts) directly shapes which markets or stalls to prioritize.
Understanding what a successful visit looks like — discovering new foods, socializing, content creation, or relaxation — determines how to measure the goal as done.
Knowing preferred days and times helps map visits to actual market schedules, since most street food markets only run on specific days or hours.

gold.taskTitle: Explore local street food markets this month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to visit street food markets in their local area within the current month.

questions.title: How many markets do you want to visit this month?
questions.description: Determines the scope — a one-time outing, a handful of visits, or as many as possible throughout the month.

questions.title: Which city or neighborhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the specific location so real, existing markets and their schedules can be factored into the plan.

questions.title: Who will you be going to these markets with?
questions.description: Clarifies whether this is a solo adventure, a date, a family outing, or a group trip, which changes logistics and priorities.

questions.title: What is your rough spending budget per market visit?
questions.description: Sets a financial constraint that guides how many stalls to try and whether budget-tracking should be part of the plan.

questions.title: Are there specific cuisines or dietary needs to prioritize?
questions.description: Captures food preferences or restrictions (e.g., vegan, spicy food, desserts, Asian street food) to target the right stalls and markets.

questions.title: What would make a market visit feel successful to you?
questions.description: Defines the goal behind the goal — whether it is discovering new dishes, relaxing, socializing, or creating content — to measure the task as truly done.

questions.title: Which days or times of week work best for you?
questions.description: Matches the user's availability to real market schedules, since most street food markets only operate on specific days and hours.
